propositions: Every mutating public plan-review entry point (CLI review-plan and library review_plan) must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default when the verdict is a non-degraded PASS.
Explicit unsigned execution requires --no-sign flag on CLI or sign=False parameter in library; omitting these defaults to signing.
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and explicit sign=False verdicts must never be signed; these guards are pinned at the attest.sign_plan_review function.
Re-running with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it without an LLM call or duplicate signature event.
PASS with signature-persistence failure returns retryable nonzero disposition and identifies sign-review as the recovery path.
